title: Project Harmony Cited Claim
description: One atomic, citation-ready claim in the Project Harmony evidence corpus. Follows the Cited Need Statement Builder conventions and adds machine fields so the live engine can verify, revalidate, and enrich each claim.

id.description: Stable claim id, e.g. 'T-02'. Domain prefix + number.

claim.description: Drop-in-ready citation sentence exactly as it should read in a proposal.

programs.description: Program tags (e.g. Anti-Trafficking, Missing Youth, MDT, MH, Connections, Training, CFS, Medical, Triage, Advocacy, Prevention).

lenses.description: Funder-lens tags (e.g. Federal, Foundation, State, United Way, Healthcare, Corporate/Tech). Bind these to Instrumentl projects at match time.

source_url.description: Canonical primary-source URL. Populated by the verify loop (Exa).

data_year.description: The year the underlying figure describes (vintage discipline).

status.description: VERIFIED-WEB = figure confirmed against source this cycle. VERIFY = stated in a secondary source or uncertain vintage; confirm before export. PULL = source identified, figure must be extracted directly. INTERNAL = relies on non-public PH data.

last_verified.description: ISO date the verify loop last confirmed this claim.

expiry.description: When this figure is expected to go stale / when the next edition releases. Drives revalidation.

red_team_flags.description: Framing/vintage/comparability risks a knowledgeable reviewer could challenge, with the fix noted inline.

efficacy_evidence.description: Peer-reviewed backing attached from Consensus that this program model works. Turns a need claim into a need+efficacy pairing.
